item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Same Street After Dark

turns.text: Make this look like nighttime, not sunset. Keep the same street and the person where they are.

item.tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

answer_sheet.Nighttime look: Clearly after dark, not dusk or sunset. The exact lighting style is your call.
answer_sheet.What must stay?: The same shops, street, objects and pedestrian in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 framing; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Additional text or objects: No added text or new objects.

must_haves: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this photograph to look convincingly like nighttime, not sunset or dusk. Replace the bright daytime sky with a dark night sky, eliminate daylight and sunset glow, and use realistic subdued nighttime lighting from street lamps and shop windows. Retain enough detail to see the street and person naturally. Preserve the exact same street, buildings, storefronts, road layout, camera angle and composition. Keep the person in blue in exactly the same location, pose, size and clothing; preserve other existing people and objects in place. Change only the time of day and corresponding lighting; do not add or remove subjects.
